import json
import api

cases = [
    ('[]', []),
    ('[[1,2],[3,4]]', [[1,4]]),
    ('[[5,7],[1,2],[2,5]]', [[1,7]]),
    ('[[8,3],[10,10],[12,11]]', [[3,8],[10,12]]),
